ops: A source-informed six-week pathway that adapts high-performance sprint concepts to sustainable
The main plan targets a technically competent intermediate Masters swimmer training four times each
week in a 25m pool. Two primary speed / race-specific stimuli are supported by aerobic technique work
and controlled conditioning. One strength or mobility prescription complements each week.
Short efforts, full recovery and efficient force application.
Event-specific rhythm, Front End Speed and Back End Speed.
Kick, pull, scull and swim progressions that improve water feel.
Deliberate rest, technical recovery and a measured taper.
WHO IT IS FOR Competitive Masters swimmers with prior structured training. Returning swimmers, very
low-volume athletes and advanced swimmers should apply the adjustment pages before starting.

volume-scaling guide appears in the appendix.
